Recommendation

Keep these as optional repair layers while Claude continues the lower map. Replace either PNG independently if you prefer another treatment. The repair is slightly smoother at 3×; the upper forest seam, lower plot edges, east join, block-like rock and riverside slab still need work.

Checks and scope

Measured: 9.21% of ground pixels changed; 0 changed outside the two patch masks. Original building assembly reproduced exactly. No gameplay or runtime code changed. Source images retained; one Image Gen edit, no PixelLab calls. Asset sources, terms and rebuild instructions are in README.md alongside this page.
